title: TVAE
summary: A standalone Python package implementing a Tabular Variational Autoencoder (TVAE) for synthetic tabular data generation, using rdt's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder transformers to preprocess columns before training. It depends on SDV's rdt transformer library directly to reproduce SDV/CTGAN-style mode-specific data transformation.
